decisions.reason: The source specifies initial host selection and outreach messaging, not the later handling of interested host conversations.
The outreach method does not change where interested leads are recorded or when they are transferred to the CRM.
The source does not discuss storing completed work, linked documents, or supporting links.
Although Airbnb outreach is among the daily assignments, the source changes only how that outreach is performed and establishes no new assignment set, deadline, or completion quota.
Selecting Airbnb hosts for outreach is unrelated to researching and selecting CJ Dropshipping products.
The source does not alter TikTok Shop product publication behavior.
The source gives target-specific Airbnb outreach instructions and does not change the general fallback rule for independently selecting work when an assignment is unavailable.
The source does not change Shopify publication destinations, sequencing, categories, or product counts.
The Airbnb outreach message does not affect cross-channel product listing records or spreadsheet structure.
The source does not concern completion, visibility, or storage of the CRM structure document.
